resources.string: Unless you choose otherwise below, Linux sees only the project folders you open and Download › OpenCode, not your whole storage. To open those folders, Android asks you to give this app All files access, its one permission for files in shared storage.
Let Linux see all shared storage
Use the older storage access instead of selected project folders. Changes apply when the phone server starts again.
Agents running in Linux will be able to read and change files outside your opened projects.
Protection keeps Linux limited to selected project folders.
Folder access is saved. Restart the phone server from This phone when your work is ready, then refresh Files. No server has been stopped.
Could not read or save folder access. Try again.
Not allowed. Allow All files access to open projects that are in shared storage.
Allowed: this app has All files access. To turn it off, open Android Settings › All files access.
